title: Mixed Event — The Climax! Kamiyama Cheer Squad! — Episode4 A Twist

meta.Event Outline: With the Sports Festival just around the corner, Kamiyama High School is abuzz with talk of the renowned cheering competition, which also piques Rui's interest. Suddenly, Mizuki approaches him with a request...

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Campus

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
That's correct, Akiyama...
He is my archrival. The one who made me taste the bitterness of defeat last time.

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line: I've had the misfortune of knowing this one for too long. We've been cheering for our respective classes since kindergarten.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Since kindergarten?!

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line: That's right. It's been a back-and-forth tug-of-war since that time, and we're at one victory a piece for high school. Everything's riding on this year's competition.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: And I'm going to win...

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Hah! After what happened last time?!
I even have the best of the best this year.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
He's right!
We weren't expecting Rui to direct your performance... But the red team has me, Tsukasa Tenma, a future star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Only victory can shine the path to stardom! Let us both fight fair and square on the day of!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Mind keeping it down...?
Some students have club activities right now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, right.
Excuse me. I got a bit ahead of myself.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: I know that you're going to be ready for whatever's thrown at you. This Sports Festival in particular since it's going to be our last hurrah...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: You're surely coming up with a plan that's going to let you bring out your full potential... However, I too have an ally who's promised to walk alongside us!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
You see no half-measures from me.
Let us meet on the field of honor!

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Heh. Just don't bore us.
All of you, let's go...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll meet again!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There they go...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The red cheer squad seems to be in high spirits.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, but I don't really get why they came all this way to see us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, I didn't realize Akito was on the cheer squad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of performance they put on, but we're not about to lose to them!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Now that we know what the captain's archrival is like, we can practice for our performance like there's no tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Yes, let's practice!
Kamishiro, we'll need you to keep working your directing magic!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I plan on doing just that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The red team's given us a reason to band together as a squad.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'll need to do everything I can to make our performance a good one...)
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay...
That should be enough for today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, is it just me or did our last run go amazingly well?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Totally!
That was like the best we've synced so far!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Thanks to your direction, Kamishiro, I'm starting to get the hang of playing Liu Bei. I really appreciate you doing this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's much too soon to thank me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, everyone's starting to move the way I imagined after practicing for consecutive days.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And we have a few days until the Sports Festival... We should be more than ready by then.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But the opening scene where Liu Bei and his troops all enter at once... I feel like there's still room for improvement.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We're talking about a general who decided the fate of a kingdom. He needs to stand out more... Ideally, from a high place...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But we don't have a platform or scaffolding to help us with that. In that case...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I know. If we can use the buildings on campus... But that means we'd all have to move outside from there...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's it...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kamishiro?
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I've come up with a great idea.
From the top of one of the buildings, we could all...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I should probably give this more thought.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've all exceeded my expectations. Let's keep this up and get ready for another day of practice tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line:
Ah, yes...!
It's nice to receive your stamp of approval, Director!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Alright, let's call it a day.
All of you, make sure to stay warm by taking a hot bath and getting a good night's rest! I wouldn't want any of you to catch a cold!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's keep up the good work until the day of!
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay...
The prop for our next show's complete.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Everyone being sent up by this modified launch pad should make for an interesting sight. I can't wait to see how the audience reacts.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I haven't had a chance to work on it lately since I've been so busy with the cheer squad's performance.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The cheer squad...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That idea that popped into my mind earlier... There's no reason it wouldn't raise the bar for the cheering competition by several notches.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's hardly bad or anything as it stands, but this is going to be necessary if we actually do want to experience the best cheering competition ever.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Like the others, I solemnly want to do my best to make sure we put on the best performance possible...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(I've felt that way since the beginning...
And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why can't I say it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Even if we do end up winning the actual competition... Even if everyone is overcome with joy...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(I wouldn't be satisfied... Not one bit...
I'd feel nothing but regret moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That reminds me...
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
And you came to speak with KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. He's given me some nice hints in the past, so my hope is that he'll have some advice for me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That'd be great!
Unfortunately, KAITO isn't here right now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're so sorry, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's okay.
I did sort of drop in on short notice.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... Something you want to say, but can't... That's a tricky one...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you told us about it, didn't you, Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's because all of you, including Emu and the others, are fellow show performers.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, huh...?
But your cheer squad friends are pretty much the same thing, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's true...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, what if...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Did you figure it out, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, tell us!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rui may be under a spell that prevents him from opening up to anyone other than us, Emu and the others.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A spell?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes.
Which means we need to find a way to break it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
First...
Why don't we start by looking for a sorcerer?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We won't make it in time for the Sports Festival if we do that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Plus, we don't know where to find a sorcerer!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, true...
If only we could dream one up right here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I know KAITO would've been more helpful...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, it's okay...
Thank you for listening to what I had to say.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But something about this still bothers me. Why can't I...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: At the same time, Rui, I'm actually kind of glad.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're glad...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. You told us something that you had trouble telling others. Doesn't that make us special in some way?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's like your way of showing that you trust us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Trust...

rows.Speaker: Boy A
rows.Line: I'm not doing this just because you think it's fun!

rows.Speaker: Boy B
rows.Line: Yeah! What's wrong with you, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(A part of me was still afraid...
I was subconsciously scared of being shunned by everyone again.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought I'd sort of gotten over that. I suppose this is a case of old habits dying hard...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you, Luka.
I'll try talking with everyone tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm glad I could help out even a little.
Now I can relax and...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz...♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait! Don't fall asleep there!
